text.what: Between Santiago and the port at Valparaíso, close enough to the Humboldt current for morning fog. Chile planted it in the 1980s to grow something other than cabernet.

kin.as: Grown on the cool coastal side of the range.
The same trick with fog, a hemisphere away.
